missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Наука' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'развивается'. 'Быстро' is the adverb of manner. A clean introduction to this feminine noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Науку' is the accusative object of 'люблю'; hard feminine nouns take -у. 'Очень' intensifies the feeling. A common way to state an interest.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Науки' is the genitive showing what the future belongs to. 'Современной' is the agreeing feminine genitive adjective. A core attribution pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Науке' is the dative governed by 'посвятить', which dedicates something to a recipient. 'Жизнь' is the accusative thing devoted.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Наукой' is the instrumental governed by 'заниматься', which takes the instrumental for an activity. 'Давно' adds duration. A very reusable pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Науке' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic of conversation. 'Вчера' sets the time. A natural discussion frame.

Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Науки' follows 'у' in the genitive to express possession. 'Долгая история' is the nominative thing possessed, and 'этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Науки' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'интересуют'. 'Точные' agrees as a plural adjective, and 'меня' is the accusative experiencer.

missions.phrase: Я изучаю разные науки в университете.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Науки' is the accusative plural of 'изучаю'; as an inanimate noun it keeps the nominative-plural form. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'в университете' sets the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun. 'Наука' is nominative as the predicate after the linking dash. 'Интересная' is the agreeing feminine adjective. A clean model for defining a field.
